sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Kumar Pal

Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anand Kumar Singh,G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record 2.

This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.29 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Raniya, District Kanpur Nagar with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is mother-in-law of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with son of applicant has taken place in the year 2018.

It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused Smt Suman Devi vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14379730/
1 persons, including applicant.

entities.text: Smt Suman Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
It was submitted that applicant-accused was residing separately from deceased and her husband.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

It has been further submitted that similarly placed co-accused Pramod Kumar Mishra @ Chhote Lala, who is father-in-law of deceased,
has already been enlarged on bail by this Court, the copy of which, is available on record.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is a lady and she is languishing in jail since 09.02.2024, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.

4. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of deceased and there are allegations that deceased was being harassed on account of dowry.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.

6. The bail application is allowed.
7. Let the applicantSmt Suman Devi involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii. 
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

8. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 10.4.2024 Neeraj  Smt Suman Devi vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14379730/
